You step onto the floor at the start of your shift and see guests quietly enjoying breakfast while giraffes move across the savannah outside. The pace here is different. Guests slow down and expect service that matches that rhythm. 
This is not standard waiter work, but a role in an environment where the setting is part of the experience you deliver. 
About the location 
This safari hotel in the Tilburg area is set in a unique environment where nature and hospitality come together. From the restaurant, you have a direct view of the savannah. This creates a calmer flow than in city venues, with more focus on detail and guest experience. 
The role 
As a waiter, you are involved in different moments throughout the day. You work breakfast, lunch, and dinner shifts and make sure everything on the floor runs smoothly and feels well taken care of. You work in a structured environment with a consistent team, where everyone knows what to expect from each other. 
What will you do? - Welcome and guide guests during their stay - Provide service during breakfast, lunch, and dinner - Work in a restaurant with direct views of the savannah - Deliver calm, attentive, and well-paced service - Work closely with a team of familiar colleagues 
Who are we looking for? - You have proven experience as a waiter or in a similar hospitality role - You are available for 32 hours per week - You are available at least one day during the weekend - You speak Dutch and/or English - You feel comfortable in an environment where structure and quality matter

As a Technical Operator you are responsible for operating and maintaining various technical installations within our "no hands warehouse". You will be involved in various tasks. Some of these include: 
 - Operating and checking technical installations; - Carrying out maintenance work on machines; - Identifying and solving technical problems; - Compliance with safety regulations and quality standards. 
Requirements 
There are several requirements you need to meet: 
 - Flexible and willing to work in varying shifts; - Affinity with technology and technical installations; - Excellent command of the English language; - Physically resistant to cold temperatures; - Experience as an operator is an advantage. 
Salary and benefits 
 - A challenging position in a dynamic working environment; - You will join a dynamic and international working environment in a stable and innovative European food group; - Opportunities for personal development and growth; - Prospect of a permanent contract; - Shift allowance based on different shifts; - Attractive employment conditions and a pleasant working atmosphere.

Do you enjoy working with your hands and are you interested in high-tech technology? Then this could be your next step. As an Assembler at ASML, you will work on lithography machines that are used to produce microchips for the world's most advanced technologies. You will work in ASML's cleanroom factory, a unique and highly technological working environment where precision, quality, and teamwork are essential. You do not need to know everything from day one. At ASML, you learn by doing and develop your skills step by step through training, guidance, and hands-on experience. You will work closely with experienced colleagues and become part of a team that builds complex systems with the highest level of accuracy. Wie zoeken we? We are looking for someone who enjoys practical technical work and takes pride in delivering high-quality results. You are comfortable working with your hands, have an eye for detail, and understand the importance of working accurately when assembling complex systems. You enjoy working as part of a team and are willing to help colleagues when needed. At the same time, you take responsibility for your own work and are not afraid to ask questions or take initiative when you encounter a problem. You remain calm when priorities change and approach technical challenges in a practical and structured way. You are eager to learn and open to feedback. Whether you are already experienced in mechanical assembly or are looking to take the next step in your technical career, your motivation and willingness to develop are important. Education and technical experience A vocational qualification (MBO level 3 or 4) or a bachelor's degree in a technical field, such as Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Automotive, Aerospace, or a comparable discipline. Hands-on experience in a technical production or service environment. Experience with mechanical assembly, testing, adjustment, and troubleshooting. Experience working with both larger mechanical components a

fine mechanical parts. Ability to read and understand technical drawings and work instructions. Good command of English, both written and spoken, for daily communication and documentation. Wat bieden wij je? As an Assembler at ASML, you will work in a unique high-tech environment where you can develop your technical skills and contribute to technology that is used all over the world. You will receive extensive training and guidance and have the opportunity to build a long-term career within an international organization. You can expect: A gross monthly salary of €3,771, excluding shift allowance. 25.1% shift allowance. An additional 0.65% ADV allowance. A 13th-month salary. An end-of-year bonus, based on company results. €0.21 per kilometre travel allowance, starting from 10 km one way. Extensive training and development opportunities. The opportunity to work in a highly advanced and innovative high-tech environment. Be Part of the Impact ASML develops and manufactures the world's most advanced lithography systems. These machines play a crucial role in the production of microchips, which are used in virtually all modern technologies. As an Assembler, you are an essential part of this process. Your craftsmanship, precision, and attention to detail ensure that complex components and systems are assembled correctly and meet ASML's high quality standards. Every component you assemble contributes to a larger system, and every system contributes to the technology that enables the next generation of microchips. Your hands. Your craftsmanship. Your impact on the technology of tomorrow. As an Assembler, you will build complex systems step by step, following clear work instructions and technical drawings. jobs.occupation: Chef Asian Cuisine at ASML (day shift)
jobs.description: You will work in our unique Asian food outlet, where guests are immersed in the rich and diverse flavours of Asia. You'll be part of an international team of colleagues from Thailand, Indonesia, Vietnam and the Netherlands, bringing together a wealth of experience and authentic culinary traditions. What you'll do: Prepare fresh Asian-inspired lunch dishes every day, including hot meals, street food, noodle dishes, sushi bowls and other creative specials. Work in an open kitchen, interacting directly with guests. Handle administrative tasks such as processing orders, carrying out quality checks and completing weekly reports. Working hours You'll work on weekdays between 7:00 AM and 4:00 PM. Evenings and weekends are yours to enjoy. Wat neem je mee? You hold a level 3 vocational chef diploma and have relevant experience; You are passionate about cooking, especially Asian cuisine; You are comfortable with computers for administrative tasks; You have knowledge of HACCP and food safety regulations; You preferably speak English; your colleagues also speak Thai, Vietnamese, and Dutch. Terms of employment A gross monthly salary between €2,900 and €3,678 (based on full-time employment), in accordance with the Hospitality Collective Labour Agreement (CAO). 8% holiday allowance, 25 vacation days and a solid pension scheme. Travel allowance of €0.23 per kilometre from 10 km onwards. A contract tailored to your availability and preferences, with the possibility of a permanent position. Excellent training and development opportunities through our Hai Academy. Great employee benefits, including discounts on sports memberships, products, days out and many other perks that support your wellbeing and work-life balance.

About the function
A job is to operate a CNC Daewoo/Puma 240 lathe with a Fanuc control system. 
The main tasks include setting up, operating, and monitoring the CNC machine, machining metal components (mainly steel and stainless steel) according to technical drawings and tolerances, and performing quality checks using standard measuring tools (caliper, micrometer, etc.).
The operator will be responsible for changing tools, loading and adjusting programs in the Fanuc control when necessary, and reporting any deviations or technical issues to the supervisor.
About the company
A specialist in process technology with decades of experience delivering fully integrated systems for handling powders, granules, and pellets. Known for in-house engineering, high efficiency, and solutions tailored to the food, feed, dairy, and chemical industries. Recognized for innovation, reliability, and end-to-end control.

Experience with CNC turning and Fanuc, experience with work in a similar environment is a plus. Speaking English (B1 level), reading technical drawings is a must.
